reason: An opt-in MXC sandbox provider for DSH that supplies controlled subprocess execution, file-effect policy, environment handling, and result settlement for bash and PTY plugins.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 的 Bash 和 PTY 插件提供可选的 MXC 沙盒能力，包括受控子进程执行、文件效果策略、环境处理和结果结算。
summaries.en: An opt-in MXC sandbox provider for DSH Bash and PTY plugins, supporting controlled subprocess execution, file-effect policies, environment handling, and result settlement.

capabilities: Provides an opt-in sandbox for subprocess execution
Applies file-effect policies to launched processes
Preserves command arguments, working directory, and environment
Uses native executors and releases per-run capture artifacts
Integrates with the DSH sandbox seam and MXC SDK
